ranking.reason: Three specific, visible pains (AI that cannot be turned off, no app lock, lost entries after an update) map directly to features an ad can name, and a lock or no-AI promise is easy to tap on.

Distrust of bank linking and third-party data sharing is a strong, emotional motive, but the five established competitors and the reviewer who said they need bank linking make the promise harder to believe in an ad.
The complaints are mostly reliability bugs (unsaved state, data loss, offline failure) that an ad cannot credibly fix before the app is proven, and four bill apps already compete for the same users.
